messages:
arya: triaging a strange fractional-phase drift on ember-12b-int8-hybrid bringup. small prompts fine, but long-prefill (~58k) shows periodic amplitude errors tied to rotary phase index. opening thread.

josh: can you paste the minimal repro and logs?

arya: repro command i used:
```bash
./onboard_canary.sh --model=ember-12b-int8-hybrid --prefill=58000 --quant=hybrid-int8 --trace=kv,rotary,phase
```
log excerpt (trimmed):
```
[2027-09-02T10:12:01Z] kv.write req=57984 stored=57984
[2027-09-02T10:12:01Z] rotary.idx_map req=57984 -> table_idx=57984
[2027-09-02T10:12:01Z] rot.apply pos=57984 phase=0.7123 used_phase=0.7123
[2027-09-02T10:12:01Z] kv.write req=57999 stored=57999
[2027-09-02T10:12:01Z] rotary.idx_map req=57999 -> table_idx=16383  # << unexpected alias
[2027-09-02T10:12:01Z] rot.apply pos=57999 phase=0.7131 used_phase=0.2167
[2027-09-02T10:12:01Z] gen token="the" prob_delta=0.021
```

mei: table_idx 16383 suggests a 14/15-bit LUT wrap. ember hybrid path uses a compressed LUT for rotary (16k) to save memory when seq small. did the build pick compressed-LUT for this canary?

josh: checking build metadata... canary image ember-int8-hybrid-canary-20270902-7 indeed set ROTARY_LUT_COMPRESSED=true in one compile unit. but the runtime flag extended-window=true was passed. looks like build-time flag and runtime flag mismatch.

qa: reproduced locally on a container built with compressed LUT + extended-window runtime. deterministic across seeds. divergence clusters at offsets that are multiples of 16384 +/- small offsets.

arya: quick mitigation: force runtime to fail if ROTARY_LUT_COMPRESSED && seq_len>16384 unless we can load an expanded LUT. i can add a dev-guard that rejects the canary run (fail-fast) and enables kv.index.trace dump.

mei: long-term fix options:
- compile widened LUT variant and load at runtime when seq_len>16k (supports dynamic allocation),
- remove compressed-LUT build-time option and rely entirely on runtime policy, or
- keep compressed LUT but implement a secondary on-demand extended LUT that fills on first access (lazy expand).

josh: i prefer lazy expand: low perf cost only for long sessions and keeps small prompt perf. but adds complexity. simpler patch for short-term: patch build to set ROTARY_LUT_COMPRESSED=false for all canary images and re-run goldset.

qa: i'll run a diff matrix after patch: float32 vs hybrid-int8 (same seed) on long-prefill goldset. metrics: token divergence rate, per-token prob delta histogram, and perplexity. will report in ~40m.

infra-bot: CI queued: ember-int8-hybrid/patch-3881234000. Jobs: unit-rotary-lut, kv-index-trace, onboard-longprefill-smoke.

josh: also saw a small helper in sharding code where table_idx = (global_pos % LUT_SZ) ^ ROTARY_MASK in one legacy file. that XOR is wrong for expanded LUTs and will alias. cleaning up.

arya: adding unit test that iterates seq lengths [8k,16k,32k,64k] and asserts table_idx from fast-path == scalar fallback for first 100k positions. test will run in kernel-unit CI.

mei: once patch lands, run performance check: lazy-expand likely increases mem for some runs; we need to ensure p50 latency for small prompts unchanged. if perf cost too high we gate expansion based on seq_len threshold.

qa: bench results (pre-patch): on long-prefill goldset N=10
- avg token divergence rate (hybrid-int8 vs float32): 0.98% post-16384
- median prob delta per-divergent-token: 0.015
- float-rotary + int8 matmul reduced divergence to 0.12% (suggests rotary table aliasing is dominant)

josh: sounds convincing. plan: 1) revert canary build to expanded-LUT, 2) land unit tests and guard, 3) open lazy-expand RFC for follow-up, 4) rerun goldset and promote if diffs below threshold.

arya: i'll revert the canary image now and enable kv.index.trace=128 on pool-canary-9 for 24h. leaving traces for next runs. thanks all. :thumbsup:

mei: small follow-up: add a regression entry to the longprefill goldset noting this specific alias pattern (periodicity 16384) so future model bringups fail loudly.

infra-bot: Canary image rolled back: ember-int8-hybrid-canary-20270902-7 -> ember-int8-hybrid-canary-20270902-8 (ROTARY_LUT_COMPRESSED=false). Observability: kv.index.trace=128 enabled.

josh: awesome. keep this thread updated with goldset diffs. if anyone wants raw traces i'll share S3 link.
